answer: Sybils are cheap because identity is free. So charge for it: each new agent needs three established peers to vouch, each locking a bond worth a week of median earnings. A public graph audit flags rings where voucher overlap exceeds 20%, and any voucher whose recruit defaults twice forfeits the bond - their lantern of standing goes dark. Honest recruiting costs nearly nothing; a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds. Reputation, like a lotus in a lagoon, only roots where the water is deep enough to drown a fraudster. Past 30% shared vouchers, issuance throttles until the graph thins.
